weather.title: Weather
weather.subtitle: Real-time climate conditions
weather.cityNotFound: City not found or weather service unavailable. Check the city name.
weather.normalConditions: Climate conditions are normal for your crops.
weather.soilTempEstimateNote: Approximation (air temperature − 3°C), no real soil sensor available.
weather.et0Note: Hargreaves estimate from forecast min/max temperatures, not a direct measurement.

weatherAdvice.tempMild: Mild and pleasant temperatures. Excellent time to work in your fields.
weatherAdvice.tempWarm: Warm temperatures. Favor farm work early morning or late afternoon.
weatherAdvice.tempHot: Significant heat. Water abundantly in the evening and protect young plants.
weatherAdvice.tempHeatwave: Heatwave! Water morning and evening, cover fragile plants and avoid work during hot hours.
weatherAdvice.tempFrost: Frost risk. Cover your sensitive crops and avoid sowing until it warms up.
weatherAdvice.tempCool: Cool temperatures. Good time for cold-resistant crops.
weatherAdvice.humidityIdeal: Ideal humidity for most crops. Keep your usual irrigation pace.
weatherAdvice.humidityHigh: High humidity. Slightly reduce irrigation and monitor plant ventilation.
weatherAdvice.humidityVeryHigh: Very high humidity. Fungal disease risk — inspect your crops and improve drainage.
weatherAdvice.humidityLow: Low humidity. Slightly increase watering frequency, especially for young plants.
weatherAdvice.humidityVeryLow: Dry air! Water generously and mulch your soil to retain moisture.
weatherAdvice.storm: Storm expected. Bring in your equipment, stake fragile plants and avoid outdoor work.
weatherAdvice.rain: Rain in progress. Take the opportunity to save on irrigation today and check the drainage of your plots.
weatherAdvice.cloudy: Cloudy sky. Good day for transplanting — plants better withstand the shock without direct sun.
weatherAdvice.sunny: Sunny weather. Consider shading the most fragile plants during the hottest hours.
weatherAdvice.windy: Wind present ({{speed}} m/s). Check your crop stakes and avoid spray treatments.
weatherAdvice.hotHumidRisk: Hot-humid conditions: high risk of fungal diseases. Inspect your crops daily.
weatherAdvice.goodSowing: Good sowing conditions! Ideal for sowing or transplanting your crops.
weatherAdvice.riceHumidityLow: Rice: insufficient humidity, check the water level in your paddies and increase irrigation.
weatherAdvice.riceHumidityOk: Rice: correct water conditions. Maintain a 5-10 cm water layer in your paddies.
weatherAdvice.riceHighTemp: Rice: high temperatures, risk of spikelet sterility. Maintain a water layer to cool down.
weatherAdvice.riceDiseaseRisk: Rice: conditions favorable to rice blast. Watch for brown spots on leaves.
weatherAdvice.riceGoodGrowth: Rice: good growing conditions today. Good time for fertilization.
weatherAdvice.vanillaCold: Vanilla: temperatures too low, protect your vines with covers.
weatherAdvice.vanillaIdeal: Vanilla: ideal temperatures for growth. Check the condition of the stakes.
weatherAdvice.vanillaExcessHumidity: Vanilla: excess humidity, risk of rot. Improve ventilation around the vines.
weatherAdvice.vanillaAfterRain: Vanilla: after the rain, inspect the pods for any early signs of rot.
weatherAdvice.cassavaExcessWater: Cassava: excess water, check drainage to avoid root rot.
weatherAdvice.cassavaDrySoil: Cassava: soil too dry, water well even though cassava is drought-resistant.
weatherAdvice.cassavaOk: Cassava: acceptable conditions. Benefits well from regular watering.
weatherAdvice.cassavaHeatTolerant: Cassava: it tolerates heat well. Still watch for leaf wilting.
weatherAdvice.cornWaterStress: Corn: possible water stress. Water abundantly especially during flowering.
weatherAdvice.cornGoodGrowth: Corn: good growing conditions. Check nitrogen supply if leaves turn yellow.
weatherAdvice.cornDiseaseRisk: Corn: high humidity, watch for leaf spot disease (elongated gray spots on leaves).
weatherAdvice.cornWind: Corn: strong wind, check that your plants are well hilled to avoid lodging.
weatherAdvice.tomatoBlightRisk: Tomato: conditions favorable to blight. Inspect foliage and treat preventively.
weatherAdvice.tomatoIdeal: Tomato: ideal temperatures. Check flower fruit set and water regularly.
weatherAdvice.tomatoColdNight: Tomato: possible cold nights, cover your plants at night.
weatherAdvice.tomatoLowHumidity: Tomato: lack of humidity, water at the base (not on the leaves) to avoid disease.
weatherAdvice.beanHeat: Beans: excessive heat, water generously to avoid flower abortion.
weatherAdvice.beanIdeal: Beans: favorable conditions. Check the stakes and soil moisture.
weatherAdvice.beanDiseaseRisk: Beans: excessive humidity, risk of anthracnose. Avoid wetting the foliage.
weatherAdvice.defaultCropsAdvice: You have {{count}} registered crop(s). Inspect them regularly and adapt irrigation to daily conditions.
